title: Laravel native model output selection fragment
description: Supplemental schema for output-selection properties on a native New Model draft. Other draft properties are validated by the plugin. Every selected name must belong to the same draft; this cross-reference validation is enforced natively. This is not a project generator configuration document.

factoryFields.description: Factory definition entries. Omitted/null selects all fields plus a manually generated primary key; [] selects none. Automatic increment/UUID/ULID keys cannot be selected.

resourceFields.description: Resource scalar entries. Omitted/null selects the primary key and all declared fields; [] selects none.

resourceRelations.description: Resource raw whenLoaded relation entries. Omitted/null selects every declared relation; [] selects none. No resource wrapper class names are accepted.
